schema.name: Station
schema.description: A reference record published by Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA). It lets consumers label, group, and route the live measurement or forecast events.

station_id.description: NEA station identifier, e.g. 'S109', 'S50'. Matches the device_id field in the NEA API metadata.

device_id.description: Device identifier, typically identical to station_id.

name.description: Human-readable station name describing the location, e.g. 'Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5', 'Changi'.

data_types.description: Comma-separated list of observation types this station reports. Values: 'air_temperature', 'rainfall', 'relative_humidity', 'wind_speed', 'wind_direction'.

schema.name: WeatherObservation
schema.description: A current environmental measurement from Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA). It carries weather observations, air-quality readings, and environmental indexes when the upstream feed reports a new or refreshed value.

observation_time.description: Timestamp of the observation in ISO 8601 with Singapore timezone (+08:00).

air_temperature.description: Air temperature from the air-temperature endpoint.

rainfall.description: Rainfall amount in the last 5 minutes from the rainfall endpoint.

relative_humidity.description: Relative humidity from the relative-humidity endpoint.

wind_speed.description: Wind speed from the wind-speed endpoint.

wind_direction.description: Wind direction in degrees clockwise from true north, from the wind-direction endpoint.

schema.name: Region
schema.description: A reference record published by Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA). It lets consumers label, group, and route the live measurement or forecast events.

region.description: Region identifier. One of: west, east, central, south, north.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the region label location as published by the NEA API.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude of the region label location as published by the NEA API.

schema.name: PSIReading
schema.description: A current environmental measurement from Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA). It carries weather observations, air-quality readings, and environmental indexes when the upstream feed reports a new or refreshed value.

timestamp.description: Observation period start timestamp in ISO 8601 with timezone.

update_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the NEA API last updated this reading.

psi_twenty_four_hourly.description: 24-hour PSI value. The overall Pollutant Standards Index for the region. Scale: 0-50 Good, 51-100 Moderate, 101-200 Unhealthy, 201-300 Very Unhealthy, above 300 Hazardous.

pm10_twenty_four_hourly.description: PM10 24-hour concentration used to calculate the PM10 PSI sub-index.

co_sub_index.description: Carbon monoxide (CO) sub-index component of PSI.

so2_sub_index.description: Sulphur dioxide (SO2) sub-index component of PSI.

schema.name: PM25Reading
schema.description: A current environmental measurement from Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA). It carries weather observations, air-quality readings, and environmental indexes when the upstream feed reports a new or refreshed value.

timestamp.description: Observation period start timestamp in ISO 8601 with timezone.

update_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the NEA API last updated this reading.

description: Singapore NEA Environment publishes weather observations, air-quality readings, and environmental indexes from Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA) for Singapore weather and air-quality regions and stations. These events help consumers build monitoring, alerting, analytics, and dashboards without polling the upstream API directly.
